newsitem.title: USA: Bio-Vascular to file marketing requests.
newsitem.headline: Bio-Vascular to file marketing requests.

text.p: Bio-Vascular Inc said Tuesday it expects to file two 510(k) marketing requests within the next few months, one for intracardiac patching and one for a new version of Petri-Strips.
"When the intracardiac 510(k) is cleared to market, the company's tissue will be marketable in several more applications," said president John Karcanes in a statement.

"The new Petri-Strip product is designed to be very efficient for surgeons performing lung volume reduction surgery via thorascope and is expected to increase the rate of product acceptance in Europe," Karcanes added.
Bio-Vascular earlier posted January 31 first-quarter earnings of $0.01 a share, compared to $0.02 a share in the same 1996 period. Revenues were $2.3 million, down from $2.8 million.

It also reported results for its Vital Images Inc unit, which will be spun off to shareholders this spring. Vital Images had an operating loss of $835,000 compared to a year-ago operating loss of $665,000. Revenue advanced to $152,000 from $143,000.
It said beta sites were chosen for Vitrea, Vital Image's new 3-D medical imaging versions of its software.
